title: Use only registered health practitioners
what: Doctors (and other registered health professionals) working in the practice must be registered under the Health Practitioner Regulation National Law, through Ahpra and the Medical Board of Australia.

laws.title: Health Practitioner Regulation National Law (ACT) Act 2010 (ACT)

sources.title: Health Practitioner Regulation National Law (Queensland)
sources.quote: (1) A person must not knowingly or recklessly— (a) take or use a title in the Table to this section, in a way that could be reasonably expected to induce a belief the person is registered under this Law in the health profession listed beside the title in the Table, unless the person is registered in the profession

reach.note: Health services using practitioners in the registered professions.

assessment.summary: Health services may use only practitioners registered under the national law to practise and use protected titles.

marks.reason: Only registered practitioners may practise and use protected titles, narrowing the pool of practitioners a practice can hire; registration is national, so it carries across states.
